headline: Samsung’s Switch 2-ready MicroSD Express card is on sale for less than $50
summary: Samsung's P9 MicroSD Express card is currently discounted. The 256GB version is $47.99, and the 512GB is $99. This is a significant saving for future Nintendo Switch 2 owners.

headline: Anthropic is burning gas to feed the AI boom
summary: Anthropic's S-1 filing highlights generative AI's reliance on methane. Data centers face intense competition for electrical supply and adequate power. The company acknowledges increasing dependence on natural gas for AI infrastructure.

headline: iPhone Duo now supports Apple Pencil with iOS 27.2
summary: iOS 27.2 update brings Apple Pencil support to the iPhone Duo. A new 'Edge Light' feature enhances video calls by illuminating faces. This fulfills Apple's earlier promise for Pencil support on the device.

headline: The NBA’s response to gambling scandals is to add more gambling partnerships
summary: The NBA announced new 'preferred' prediction market deals with Kalshi and Polymarket. This comes despite controversies like FTX Arena and plunging NBA Top Shot NFT sales. The league expands gambling ties amid past market failures.

headline: Join IGN and Toyota at Our Gaming Booth at Los Angeles Comic-Con
summary: IGN and Toyota are co-hosting a gaming booth at Los Angeles Comic-Con. Attendees are invited to participate in gaming activities. The booth offers a unique interactive experience at the event.

headline: Toastie Might Be the Weirdest iPhone Duo Game So Far
summary: Toastie is identified as potentially the most unusual game for iPhone Duo. The article suggests an unconventional and quirky gameplay experience. Users are teased with the bizarre nature of this new title.

headline: Hunger Games Director Hopes You Aren't Too Distracted With GTA 6 to See Sunrise on the Reaping
summary: Francis Lawrence, director of the BioShock movie, discussed his favorite video games. He playfully hopes GTA 6 doesn't overshadow his new Hunger Games release. The director demonstrates a strong understanding of gaming culture.

headline: Red Rising Director Francis Lawrence Says YA Series' Movie Adaptation Is a 'Priority' at Paramount Following Shelved Netflix Show
summary: Director Francis Lawrence shared exciting updates on the 'Red Rising' movie. The film adaptation is now a top 'priority' at Paramount Pictures. This follows a previous Netflix show for the YA series that was shelved.

headline: Independent review announced into murder of student Henry Nowak
summary: An independent review has been launched into the murder of student Henry Nowak. The home secretary emphasized the need to uncover the full truth. The review will examine events before, during, and after the tragic night.

headline: Israel and the US are both going to the polls - the consequences will be global
summary: Two upcoming elections in Israel and the US will have global consequences. The outcomes are expected to reshape geopolitics significantly. These polls will also impact the global economy.

headline: Drivers who killed mum and girl while racing jailed
summary: Drivers have been jailed after killing Justyna Hulboj and her daughter Lena. The mother and child died in January 2023, hit by a racing car in Leeds. The sentencing brings some justice for the tragic incident.

headline: Storm Boelo leaves 22,000 without power as Met Office issues new wind warning
summary: Storm Boelo has cut power to 22,000 homes across the UK. The Met Office issued a fresh wind warning for several regions. Strong winds are expected along the west coast of England, Wales, Scotland, and eastern Northern Ireland.
